hints.content: Charlie can type at the rate of $700$ words in $\red5$ minutes.  What is his speed?

To get the speed, we want to know how many words Charlie can type in one minute:

$\dfrac{700\, \text{words}}{\red5\,\text{minutes}}=\dfrac{140\,\text{words}}{1\,\text{minute}}=140\,\text{wpm}$. 

What is the record typing speed?
From the table, we see that the fastest speed is $216$ words in $\red1$ minute, or $216\,\text{wpm}$.  Charlie may be the fastest typist in his class, but he comes nowhere near the record.
**No, Charlie types *slower* than the record speed.**

question.content:
Charlie can type faster than any of his classmates.  He took a test that showed he can type $700$ words in $5$ minutes $(\text{wpm})$.  

The fastest recorded typing speed is shown in the chart below (we assume the speed is constant for the three minutes shown).
